methodology.execution: One non-overlapping position per event; no re-entry before the holding period ends
methodology.selection: Positive event-clustered 90% lower bound, positive event median, and positive leave-one-event-out mean in training and validation
methodology.holdout: Untouched until after training and validation selection
methodology.cost_model: Fixed round-trip cents per share; historical order-book depth and fills are unavailable

closest_rule.definition: Fade an absolute 72-hour YES-price move of at least 4 percentage points and exit after 72 hours
closest_rule.stress_result: Fails the training gate at 2.5 cents and 3 cents per share
closest_rule.decision: Do not authorize capital. The expected-value result is thin, loses on most holdout events, and is not robust to modestly higher execution cost.
